text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess brilliantly achieved 
great results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san! Which training 
session should we start with?
choice_data_list: Full of energy again today, huh?

You're full of energy again today, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, vigor is power! And power is might, 
after all!
choice_data_list:
It feels like you're saying the exact same 
thing...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Hmmm...? Well, as long as muscle is 
what matters most!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Because in order for me to become the 
'ideal,' I still require far more 
strength."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...To remain someone I can be proud of, 
it is far too early for me to stop in my 
tracks."
choice_data_list: That's a true princess for you.
That's a true princess for you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes! Let's start with a light 
warm-up lap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Kawakami Princess runs the track. 
Though she calls it a warm-up, the way she 
cuts through the wind with explosive speed 
is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list:
"You can become stronger than a raging 
storm."

"You can become stronger than a raging 
storm."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"‘...My prince, how does my running... how 
does my heart appear to you?’"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...And that's enough imitating PreFie for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. How do I look in your 
eyes?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "...Please tell me in your own words."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are the greatest Trainer ever 
as well!
